artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New pure module. mention_rows(article_row, securities, weights=WEIGHTS, share_b=0.3, roundup_at=5) returns one row per covered security named at least once (word-bounded per-block match, same shape as publishers.py normalize()'s floor), carrying mention_count/mention_in_title/mention_in_lead/first_mention_block, blocks_hit/blocks_total, match_forms, vendor_tagged_primary/secondary (VENDOR_TAG_FIELDS, documented working shape), co_mentioned_securities/co_mention_count/is_roundup, signal_tier/signal_weight (assign_tier: A/B/C/D, first-match partition), the three clocks + lag_hours, and lineage (article_key, bronze_key, record_hash). security_key/composite_figi are read straight off the caller-supplied `securities` entries, never resolved inside this pure function. write_gold(table, rows, as_of_date, run_stamp, client=None) writes ONE parquet snapshot via store.address_of + form_c_object under IfNoneMatch="*", against an explicit GOLD_MENTION_SCHEMA, then HEADs it back and checks ContentLength. The `build-mention` CLI reads every source's silver `article` via store.silver_latest, builds rows, writes the snapshot, prints the summary JSON.
